recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-19691 unless a future work group decision changes the Annotation.author target set.
issue_request: FHIR-19691 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core datatypes issue from MnM, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, asking for PractitionerRole to be added to Annotation.author because the substantive change could not be made in R4.
initial_application: Commit c4807a5165ee632872ef9f6289fee8e9e1abbb5f, 'MnM changes for R5', lists FHIR-19691 and changes source/datatypes/annotation.xml from Reference(Practitioner|Patient|RelatedPerson|Organization)|string to Reference(Practitioner|PractitionerRole|Patient|RelatedPerson|Organization)|string for Annotation.author[x].
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Annotation as an active datatype and normative artifact, so source/datatypes/annotation.xml is current build input. Duplicate FHIR-20381 makes the same PractitionerRole request; FHIR-16965 separately rejected adding Group as Annotation author; FHIR-23839 later added authorString guidance without changing the authorReference target set. MnM 2019-01-29 minutes corroborate tracker 19691 as Persuasive. No relevant Zulip discussion was found that changes the source/Jira conclusion.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/datatypes/annotation.xml already contains PractitionerRole in the Annotation.author[x] Reference target list.

Later clarification discourages Annotation.authorString in favor of Annotation.authorReference.display and does not reverse the PractitionerRole target.
